item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q014_paper_example_reclassification_pa1492","answer":"In SCOP 1.69, PA1492 (1t1j; d1t1ja_/d1t1jb_) was c.137.1.1, whereas nucleoside 2-deoxyribosyltransferase (1f8y; d1f8ya_/d1f8yb_) was c.23.14.1. They therefore shared only the alpha/beta class (c) and were assigned to different folds, superfamilies, and families. In the current SCOPe 2.08 release, the protein-bearing PA1492 domains (d1t1ja1/d1t1jb1, residues 1–118) are reclassified as c.23.14.2, while 1f8y remains c.23.14.1. They now share the c.23 fold and c.23.14 N-(deoxy)ribosyltransferase-like superfamily, supporting remote evolutionary homology, but remain in separate families: hypothetical protein PA1492 (c.23.14.2) and N-deoxyribosyltransferase (c.23.14.1).
